title: CONNECT-IP URI Template Validation Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP URI Template validation for level, form, components, path, and variable placement.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIpUriTemplate` validates CONNECT-IP URI Templates as absolute printable-ASCII templates with non-empty scheme, authority, and explicit slash-prefixed path, rejects level 4 expansion operators, and requires all template variables to appear in the path or query components.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper stores the original template and parsed absolute URI only; expansion and target/ipproto validation are separate slices.
edge_cases_and_constraints: The original template text is checked for an explicit slash-prefixed path because URI parsing normalizes a missing path to `/`.
Authority-level variables are rejected before request construction.
Level 4 URI Template operators are rejected conservatively.
risks: Additional CONNECT-IP variable expansion and default-template behavior remain later requirements.
